title: Mac Quack
blurb: Classic Macintosh computers genuinely shipped with a duck quack as a system alert, decades before notification design became a discipline with conferences attached. Apple put a bird in the machine and nobody has improved on it since. An error that quacks at you is impossible to take personally, which is more than can be said for anything that has replaced it. Retro-computing gold. Play it for mistakes that deserve whimsy rather than alarm, and for anybody nostalgic for an era when computers were allowed to be silly.
origin: The classic Macintosh 'Quack' system alert from vintage Mac OS.
